summary: Grupo Aval's Form 6-K reports the completed divestiture of 99.57% of Multi Financial Group Inc. (MFG) via its subsidiary Multi Financial Holding, Inc. to BAC International Corporation (BIC), a BAC Holding International Corp. subsidiary. The share purchase agreement was signed November 27, 2025, and closed March 18, 2026, after regulatory approvals and conditions precedent. No price per share, premium, or valuation is disclosed. The filing presents pro forma financials reclassifying MFG as discontinued operations for comparability. The deal is structured as a cash sale of a controlling stake. Watch for integration by BAC and Grupo Aval’s redeployment of proceeds.
